reviews.author: Brenda Mullens
reviews.text: What fast and efficient service i received today! My truck wouldn't start at Roxboro Animal Hospital and StrutDaddy's Complete Car Care took care of me and called Brandon's Wrecker Service! My Dog Boomer and I were able to get a ride back to Mebane and then after he dropped the truck off at County Ford in Graham. I was very happy with the cost ..... give these guys a call! You won't be stranded long.

reviews.author: Tracey Crabtree
reviews.text: Mike from Brandon's wrecker service just brought me my car and I have to say that he was respectful, professional, and just all around a nice guy. He had no problem trying to put my car where I wanted it and it was a tight spot. Thank you Mike you made this customer very happy.
